ledger.x: 195: Sun Ce holds Niuzhu and Danyang under Yuan Shu.

196: Kuaiji. Sun Ce 'pushed into Yang Province and conquered Kuaiji, whose governor Wang Lang surrendered' and 'made Kuaiji his base city'; the page dates no surrender. The conquest of 'the entire region southeast of the Long River' took 'less than a year' from Niuzhu (195), so 196 is the ceiling; the infobox gives…
197: Sun Ce breaks with Yuan Shu.

ledger.cp: Liu Xun (Lujiang) and the Han governors of Yuzhang

ledger.x: 206: the Jiangdong of Sun Ce and Sun Quan passes into Cliopatria's Eastern Wu row, which starts in 207.

wars.name: Sun Ce's conquest of Jiangdong
wars.outcome: Sun Ce took Danyang, Kuaiji and the west bank within about five years; he died on 5 May 200.

certainty.note: Only commandery names appear on the pages; no frontier.
